Name: (DGA) Plenty of Kid's Beds
Author: Stavetskaya
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][color=#f4cccc]This is a very simple DGA pack, it contains 10 kid's beds available in Furniture Catalogue and buyable from the Robin's shop every day in a week except Tuesdays))) [/color]


[color=#ff0000][u]IMPORTANT:[/u][/color]

[color=#f4cccc]Once you have DGA you can put the unzipped folder in your mods folder and free to use any of the items it provides.[/color]

[color=#f4cccc]It is safe to Install and Uninstall this mod in any time in your game, BUT remember to [/color][color=#ff0000][u]REMOVE ANY ITEMS[/u] [/color][color=#f4cccc](Put them into a trash can you have) from your game [/color][color=#ff0000][u]BEFORE UNINSTALLATION![/u][/color]

[color=#f4cccc]This should be compatible with pretty much anything so long as you have DGA. [/color]

[/size][size=5]Mod was tested in a plain game with basic requirements and with a game contain 200+ mods. "It just works" (c)[/size]
[size=6]
[/size][size=5]I'm not an experienced modder, so I probably can't help you with your smapi logs or errors.[/size]
[size=6]
